answer: Like mycelium weaving deep mycorrhizal roots, agents resist Sybil swarms through web-of-trust staking where each vertex represents a verified node. To mint valid consensus, an untrusted whisper must gain peer endorsement, soaring like a watchful falcon to validate authenticity across graph depths. Forging identities yields a superlinear attacker cost: bond requirements scale exponentially with network distance, starving malicious clones.
